audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, horizontal view of a vintage audio cassette tape resting on a textured red surface. The cassette has a dark gray/black plastic body with a cream-colored paper label on the top face. Visible features include two circular windows revealing the internal spools (one with reddish tape), a central rectangular window showing the tape path and pressure pad, and small molded details like screw holes and write-protection tabs along the bottom edge. There is faint digital timestamp text in the bottom left corner.
